crew.overview: Finney Blake, a shy but clever 13-year-old boy, is abducted by a sadistic killer and trapped in a soundproof basement where screaming is of little use. When a disconnected phone on the wall begins to ring, Finney discovers that he can hear the voices of the killer’s previous victims. And they are dead set on making sure that what happened to them doesn’t happen to Finney.
crew.title: The Black Phone

crew.overview: Two highly trained operatives grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.
crew.title: The Gorge

details.biography: Maggie Levin is a filmmaker with rock n' roll roots. She recently wrote & directed her debut feature MY VALENTINE for Hulu & Blumhouse's INTO THE DARK horror anthology series. Other credits include MISS 2059 (Amazon/Go90), THE FRIENDLESS FIVE (Fullscreen) and VAIN: THIS PARTY SUCKS (Nashville Film Festival), and music videos for artists such as Big Data and Fast Friends. She is the creator of THE ROCKY HORROR HIPSTER SHOW, a live club production based in Los Angeles. In 2020, she won Best Director at Austin Indie Fest for her work on the much-lauded short film HEEL.
details.name: Maggie Levin
